raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`cargo fmt --all -- --check` fails on main at `e109bc1832eebfe776a7fe87ad69c9b6550ae009` because the `configured_handle` call in `skipped_probe_passes_on_health_ack_and_cleans_up` is split across multiple lines.

## Modifications

Apply rustfmt's single-line layout to this call in `rust/sglang-server/src/api_server/core/handle.rs`. This is a formatting-only change.

## Accuracy Tests

Reproduced the reported formatting failure before the change using the repository-pinned Rust 1.92.0 toolchain. After the change, the following checks pass (run from `rust/`):

```bash
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo fmt --manifest-path sglang-radix-tree/Cargo.toml -- --check
git diff --check
```

Runtime tests are not needed for this whitespace-only change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; no runtime behavior changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Verify Rust formatting with the repository-pinned toolchain.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.
- Tests, documentation updates, and benchmarks are not applicable to this formatting-only change.
